title: Reisen zu den Quellen des Tigris … Studien von Josef Wünsch in Mesopotamien
bookshelves: Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: Josef Wünsch (1842 - 1907) undertook a three-year research activity in the eastern provinces of the Ottoman Empire. In this volume his estate (cartographic and ethnographic works and collections) is brought together and evaluated from today's scientific point of view
